We identify these noteworthy association:
We identify these noteworthy associations by first identifying the likelihood of finding a claim in a product with your selected claim. Then we compare this to the overall likelihood of seeing that claim in any product, regardless of other claims.

Instead of looking at raw counts or percentages of attribute pairings, which can be misleading, this technique helps us spot significant relationships between attribute pairings.
